capabilities: Search text inside PDFs, EPUBs and Office files
Open a result at the matching PDF page
Jump to the reference note that links a document
Warm the text-extraction cache ahead of time
Limit searches by folder, file globs and result count
extras: Desktop only. Extracted text is cached outside the vault, so nothing is added to it or synced; the first search over a large library can take over an hour, and scanned PDFs without a text layer cannot be searched.
intentEvidence: RGA Search does one narrower job: exact phrase and regex search inside documents, with page numbers
problem: Obsidian's own search covers Markdown only, so text inside the PDFs, EPUBs and Office documents in a vault cannot be found.

relations.evidence: RGA Search does one narrower job: exact phrase and regex search inside documents, with page numbers
Stacks files each PDF in your vault and links it from its reference note's pdf property.

summary: Desktop search that runs ripgrep-all over the PDFs, EPUBs and Office files in a vault and opens hits at the matching page.
